description: Takes a phasor in and puts out a phasor at a ratio of that speed, with three ways of keeping the two in phase

params.text: Divides the speed of the output phasor, from 1/512 to 512; right-click to type an exact division such as 12
Multiplies the speed of the output phasor, from 1/512 to 512; right-click to type an exact figure such as 1.01 for slow phasing
Steps through Basic Sync, which runs the output freely, Auto Sync, which realigns it at the next input cycle after a ratio change, and Hard Sync, which restarts it every input cycle
Jumps the output phasor to the current phase of the input

inputs.text: The phasor being divided and multiplied, 0-10V
A rising edge restarts the output phasor from 0V
A rising edge jumps the output phasor to the current phase of the input
Adds to the divide setting, scaled by the divide attenuverter
Adds to the multiply setting, scaled by the multiply attenuverter

outputs.text: The 0-10V phasor at the divided and multiplied rate
10V through the first half of each output cycle and 0V through the second, a 50% gate at the new rate

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
